quests.title: Cooking, the Beauty of Sharing

dialogue.t: Hi there!
*snore* *snore*
Hey! Hello—!
Mmm... Tasty fruits... *snore*
Ugh, he's in deep slumber. Oh, right. Arapacati mentioned that <color=#00E1FFFF>the power of Dendro</color> should do the trick.
Paimon will leave it to you, {NICKNAME}.
(A huge leaf. Someone has written on it with neat handwriting...)
"...Leaves turned yellow. I picked a fresh and tasty Sunsettia."
"...Branches turned green. I didn't find any fruits..."
"Leaves are growing again, and 40 moons have passed. I picked Sunsettias outside the campsite and brought them back to Vanarana, but sister said they were still very unripe..."
*snore* *snore*
Oh? It's you. Long time no see.
Whoa, where am I? Is this a cave? Ugh... I'm feeling dizzy.
Who are you? Why are you sleeping here?
Who am I... Ugh, so dizzy. Let me think... My name is...
My name is Araphala! Hehe, I remember now...
So you're Araphala! We were wondering where you'd gone... and here you were, sleeping in this cave the whole time!
Araphala... You know my name...
Eh? Nara!?
He's wide awake now.
*sob* I'm not ready yet. Don't make porridge out of me...
Huh? Why would anyone want to make porridge out of you!?
M—My sister said that if I'm always half asleep like this, a bad Nara will take me and make porridge out of me...

dialogue.sit: No one will make you into porridge.

dialogue.t: Waaah!!
Hey! {NICKNAME}, don't make jokes like that! Araphala, no one will cook you!
...Really?
Really!
Not kidding?
No kidding! Anyway, Paimon's name is Paimon, and this tall Nara is {NICKNAME}. Arapacati sent us...
Arapacati? Is she doing well? How long have I been here...
"How long," you say? Well, if Paimon recalls correctly...
Uhh... Many, many moons ago, the seedlings sprouted from the earth, and became trees... How many Arapacatis tall were they again?

dialogue.sit: Your memory is amazing as well, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Whoa! As expected of {NICKNAME}! What an amazing memory!
Oh, it's been so long. Oh no.
Anyway, let's bring you up to speed. Festival Utsava is coming up...

dialogue.sit: You bring Araphala up to speed on the events so far...

dialogue.t: Ah, it's time for Festival Utsava, is it?
Yeah, so Arapacati wants you back in Vanarana.
Ugh... But I haven't completed my cooking training yet...
Huh? Weren't you sleeping? Paimon thought...
"Sleeping"? Oh, I was just thinking about the past. It wasn't that serious.
Huh? Is sleeping something serious for Aranara?
Hmm... How should I put this... We hibernate when we are in grave danger, and we compress our memories and dreams into a seed.
If the crisis is averted and the time is right, the seed will return to the forest and grow into Aranara again.

dialogue.sit: Paimon, can you turn into a seed?

dialogue.t: But I know that all Nara must sleep. I had a Nara friend once, a Golden Nara just like you.
I once came here with him(her) to gather the Unrivaled Fresh Fruits.
So, I've been picking them here since then. If he(she) returns, or if I make new Nara friends, we can eat them together.
I've picked so many of them this time... Eh? Where did they go?
So, it's you who dropped those Sunsettias we saw all along the way.
Did I drop that many? But it's okay, hehe... I've kept the freshest and tastiest with me.
But still... How did I drop so many...
I remember leaving with my brothers for cooking training. But they didn't know that fresh fruits are the best ingredients...
But while I was picking fruits... Yes, while I was picking fruits, a really huge monster appeared.
That huge monster was five Araphalas tall and had a long tail. Even the ground quaked beneath its stomps. Besides that, I think I sensed Marana's aura inside it.
And it was so tough! Even if Arama and Arabalika were there, it would take them some effort to tear it apart.
Wait!? They are that strong!?
Yes, but I'm not. So, I had to hide here. I was thinking about the past as I waited for it to leave, and the next thing I knew, you two were standing in front of me.
Speaking of which, we did see a Ruin Drake on the way here. Is that the huge monster you mentioned?
Is that how Nara call it? Perhaps. Very likely.

dialogue.sit: Ah, that huge monster! So scary!

dialogue.t: Whoa! I didn't expect Nara {NICKNAME} who looks smaller than the monster to be so strong!
Alright, then let's go. Good Nara, let's eat fruits together.
Oh? It's you. Long time no see.
Whoa, where am I? Is this a cave? Ugh... I'm feeling dizzy.
Who are you? Why are you sleeping here?
Who am I... Ugh, so dizzy. Let me think... My name is...
My name is Araphala! Hehe, I remember now...

Araphala... You know my name...
Eh? Nara!?
He's wide awake now.

I don't want to go outside while such a scary and huge monster is roaming the area. I'm sorry, my "sister."
Oh, Paimon sees. But Festival Utsava is coming, you should return home.
Festival Utsava is meant to be carefree, but I'll care for my life if I leave this place. *snore* I can't do that for Festival Utsava...
*snore* *snore* Nara Varuna...
Ugh... This guy...
What do we do, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: Let's deal with the big scary monster.
Ah, that huge monster! So scary!

dialogue.t: ...Paimon doesn't think anything can be scarier than Stormterror. In fact, Paimon wonders how Aranara would describe Stormterror?
"To walk from its tail to the head, the moon will rise and fall!"
C'mon, let's help him deal with that monster outside.
*snore* When will you be back? *snore*

dialogue.sit: (Let's wake him up once we take care of the monster...)

dialogue.t: *snore* *snore*
Araphala!
Huh? Oh, it's Paimon.
Yeah, we are here to tell you that {NICKNAME} has taken down the huge monster outside!
Whoa! I didn't expect Nara {NICKNAME} who looks smaller than the monster to be so strong!
Alright, then let's go. Good Nara, let's eat fruits together.
Okay, let's start cooking with the Unrivaled Fresh Fruits.
What's the difference between this "Unrivaled Fresh Fruit" and ordinary fruits?
I understand. To Nara, all fruits may be the same, but they are different.
Only strong trees can bear Unrivaled Fresh Fruits. Strong trees sing first when the wind blows.
The bearings of the strong trees, these Unrivaled Fresh Fruits, are a blessing to us. That Nara friend said these fruits are so tasty they sing in your stomach.
Paimon can't wait to see what kind of delicacy will be made from them!

dialogue.sit:
Araphala starts cooking right away...
He divides the fruits equally...
Then, he gives a few portions to you and Paimon.

You try the fresh fruits together.
It sort of lives up to your expectations. They do taste like fresh fruits.

dialogue.t: So good. Thank you, strong trees.
Wait! You call that cooking?
The Unrivaled Fresh Fruit itself is the best Supreme Delicacy. It doesn't need any extra processing to present its best taste...
Just taste it and you will understand.
It is tasty, but it's just... it's just like eating fruits...

dialogue.sit: It is a fruit after all.

dialogue.t: Yeah, Paimon guesses so...
Don't you Nara have a dish where you cut fruits and serve them on a wooden board too?
Huh? Do we? Wait! Are you talking about a fruit platter?
Is a fruit platter considered a dish?
It still seems a bit strange to Paimon...
Oh, don't be a stickler for things like that. Finding better ingredients is a form of cooking too.
While searching for ingredients, I can travel the forest and get closer to it. That's the true meaning of my cooking training.
Is it?
It sure is.
I've picked Unrivaled Fresh Fruits and made my Supreme Delicacy. My cooking training is complete.
I can return proudly to Vanarana.
Oh, I would've missed Festival Utsava if Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon didn't take care of that huge monster that blocked me here in this cave.
Alright, hurry back to Vanarana!
Indeed, indeed... Sister will scold me if I miss Festival Utsava... Just the thought of it is scary enough.
Festival Utsava is coming, I must... *snore* I must hurry up...
*snore* *snore*

quests.description: According to Arachatora, his brother Araphala is doing “cooking training” close by Devantaka Mountain. Look for a pillar of smoke near Devantaka Mountain!
